   **Bugs and stability.**

         **Review examples:**
            1. _rybu0305_, Jul 25, 2026, 1/5: "They removed the ability to easily see the month from the top view and then switch to the schedule view. App is unusable now."
            2. _Heatmiser NeoApp_, May 22, 2026, 1/5: "Apple app icon shows 31st. Should be showing the correct date! Bug only affects Apple devices and not Android"
            3. _Mumakil_, Jun 11, 2026, 3/5: "It’s not bad but a few changes would get it more stars. The main issues I have are in adding an entry. Why do I have to scroll through months to get to the date I want? Drop downs to select the month and year for things way in the future would be much better. Also occasionally it freezes the keyboard when I try to enter a location. This is the only app I have that freezes anytime I’m entering information so clearly a bug in the app. Lastly why does the app icon show 31 and not the current date like the iOS calendar app does?"
